problem: The live HTML still emitted a mobile Platform anchor to /bedrijfsgeheugen because the canonical homepage is rebuilt from a pinned V18 payload.
root_cause: The pinned V18 production payload predates the product-route decision and overwrites repository homepage markup during each production build.
decision: Repair the historical Platform anchor in the canonical V18 payload projection before generated homepage output is written. Keep the runtime normalization from the previous recovery as defense in depth.
prevention: Canonical generated HTML emits Platform -> /product on desktop and mobile.
Build fails closed when the historical canonical repair point disappears unexpectedly.
Runtime navigation normalization remains defense in depth rather than the primary fix.

historical_replay: Live static homepage HTML showed desktop Platform -> /product while the mobile Platform anchor still emitted /bedrijfsgeheugen.
The pinned V18 production payload is the build authority for homepage HTML and therefore must normalize the mobile Platform route before output.
regression_contract: Generated Platform anchors resolve to /product before JavaScript executes.
